scope: Normalize four manifests whose schemas used non-standard field names (primary_handler / ultimate_callee / vftable_va / scaffolding_classes). This manifest records each promotable address in a flat proposed_bcs_y_entries list using the standard {name, kind, address} shape. The action-skill subsystem contributes 0 entries because its proposals have no concrete address. The party subsystem contributes 43 dispatcher, Group, and RTTI entries; the quest subsystem contributes 17; and the retainer-bazaar subsystem contributes 18. Existing addresses are deduplicated, for 78 entries gross.
source_manifests: manifests/action_skill_subsystem.json (0 promotable - all proposals are kind=finding/open_question with no concrete VA)
manifests/party_subsystem.json (43 promotable - dispatcher handlers + Group system callees + RTTI classes)
manifests/quest_subsystem.json (17 promotable - QuestBase + JobQuestCompleteTripleReceiver chain + dispatch machinery)
manifests/retainer_bazaar_subsystem.json (18 promotable - widget vftables + lifecycle methods)

method.step1: Read each source manifest in full to map its schema.
method.step2: For each manifest, enumerate every nested field containing a concrete VA. party_subsystem.json uses opcode_table[*].primary_handler/ultimate_callee + existing_bcs_y_links.indirectly_relevant_decomp_only[*].vftable_va. quest_subsystem.json uses scaffolding_classes[*].proposed_bcs_y_ids_if_promoted + dedicated_quest_receiver.proposed_bcs_y_ids_if_promoted + uncataloged_supporting_machinery[*]. retainer_bazaar_subsystem.json uses newRttiClassesDiscovered[*].vftableVa/scalarDeletingDtorVa/slot4InitVa/tickSlotVa.
method.step3: Hand-extract each entry with a clear name + kind + address + provenance summary. Avoid scraping the JSON because the source names are field-name fragments (primary_handler, ultimate_callee) that need translation into the BCS-Y naming convention (subsystem_role_FUN_addr).
method.step4: The quest-subsystem pass has a known schema quirk: many JobQuestCompleteTripleReceiver addresses are stated as file_va (file offsets without image base). Image base is 0x00400000 for 1.23b - file 0x49d270 -> VA 0x0089d270 etc. Conversions noted per-entry. The quest_subsystem.json vtable_slot_inventory makes this explicit.
method.step5: BCS-Y-0539/0540/0541 in that manifest yield zero entries: they are kind=finding / kind=open_question with no address. Documentation-only artifacts that belong in the architectural findings or the open-questions record, not in symbols.json.
method.step6: Existing symbols.json addresses are matched case-insensitively before promotion.

key_findings: The party-subsystem pass is the single largest unreleased catalog tranche in the project. 43 entries promotable - 19 of 20 mid-table dispatcher cases in FUN_004DC690 (0x017A + 0x17C..0x18D) get full coverage, alongside their respective Group::PacketProcessor / SharedWork callees and the four foundational RTTI vftables (PacketProcessor, SharedWork, PacketRequestBase, Control::GroupBase). After the schema-rescue pass the party/group subsystem moves from 'documented only' to 'cataloged'.

The quest-subsystem pass closes the quest catalog gap. JobQuestCompleteTripleReceiver (0x01A2 - the single dedicated Quest opcode) gains a class vtable + ctor + slot1 + slot5 + LuaActorImpl wrapper + 2-step gated Pattern C dispatcher + JobQuestObject swapper. QuestBase scaffolding (vtable + secondary RTTI marker + ctor + factory slot1 + secondary dtor thunk + slot28 getQuestData) becomes cataloged.

The retainer-bazaar-subsystem pass closes the retainer/bazaar widget catalog gap. 12 widget vftables (6 single-base + 6 multi-base entries) plus 6 lifecycle methods (Init/dtor/tick). The 5 RetainerItemSearchMarketplace c2s emitters cataloged under BCS-Y-0324 / BCS-Y-0347 remain in place; the retainer-bazaar-subsystem pass confirms the WIDGET side that hosts those emitters.

The action-skill-subsystem pass promotes nothing. Its 3 proposed entries are pure knowledge-organization (kind=finding for the action subsystem synthesis, kind=open_question for two unresolved dispatch mysteries). Those belong in docs, not in symbols.json - they would corrupt the catalog if forced in with kind=note + placeholder addresses. Recorded here as a non-promotion for traceability.
